author: Ansel Adams
text: You don't take a photograph, you make it.

author: Dorothea Lange
text: The camera is an instrument that teaches people how to see without a camera.

author: Robert Capa
text: If your pictures aren’t good enough, you’re not close enough.

author: Henri Cartier-Bresson
text: To take a photograph is to align the head, the eye and the heart. It's a way of life.

author: Gordon Parks
text: I saw that the camera could be a weapon against poverty, against racism, against all sorts of social wrongs.

author: Elliott Erwitt
text: All the technique in the world doesn’t compensate for the inability to notice things.
